baslik: Talking About Past Events: 'Was / Were' & Action Verbs
paragraflar: Was / Were (Geçmişte Durum): Doğum, meslek ve kişisel özellikler anlatılırken I/He/She/It -> was (wasn’t), We/You/They -> were (weren’t) kullanılır.
Regular & Irregular Verbs: Geçmişteki eylemlerde olumlu cümlede V2 (moved, graduated, invented / grew, won, had, went), olumsuzda didn’t + V1, soruda Did + S + V1? kullanılır.
